summary: The admitted collision-resistant producer identity slice passes independent frozen-source and fixed-runtime review; no sink idempotency or full-package acceptance is inferred.

evidence: Inspected actual SDK/schema/action/outcome deltas. SDK nonce mint requires current readiness and tracking; bounded opaque Host tokens plus a guarded monotonically increasing per-core sequence distinguish same-clock sends. Invalid sources are caught by existing nonthrowing send. Refused envelopes mint no logical nonce.

Route validates explicit nonce and representable integer timestamp before host processing, preserves nonce-bearing timestamp zero, and supplies request-local fallback only in tracking-approved outcome emission. One outcome object with event_id/source and unchanged tenant:time:visitor prefix feeds both queue and learning.

Independent selected SDK and both-host route groups pass: same-clock distinct identities, unchanged serialized envelope, invalid nonce/time refusal before recorded effects, identical provided-identity reposts, legacy fallback and consent suppression. Legacy helper IDs remain unchanged. No persistent seen state or retry was added.

Service supplies one tracking-approved request nonce; pure decideContent validates and persists it without clock/randomness or changes to ranking/exploration inputs. Appended :n1:<nonce> preserves existing partition/visitor prefix and old ID tail.

Replay reuses request_id and compares exact decision_id/request_id; malformed present nonce, missing nonce on a suffixed carrier and inconsistent IDs fail rather than downgrade. Historical generated IDs and legitimate page/slot text containing :n1: remain distinguishable by reconstruction.

Actual service same-clock requests have distinct IDs and equal decisions; new/legacy replay and three existing pure/replay cases pass. The corrected pure fixture explicitly produces one eligible record, avoiding vacuous equality. Existing background erasure and W09.04 caller checks also pass.

Read all sixteen exact deltas: ten production/type files, three fixtures, two generated SDK outputs and kit contract. Before and after runtime, all 108 artifact pins and 86 protected source pins match; sixteen forward/reverse patches reconstruct exact baseline/current bytes. Contract, artifact, worker STOP hashes and parity output hashes reconcile.
Exact admitted K3 compound invoked once: 15 selected pass, zero failures; 81 unselected cases not credited. Full real captures below end with exit 0 and are drained.

Reused fully inspected worker final static 3053/ec0531: compiler, scoped lint and whitespace pass; 114 inherited warnings match baseline rule/message sequence with line shifts only. Reused successful SDK builder/parity captures 20fe23/5fbe1e; all parity input paths are pinned, and both output hashes match current files. No reviewer build/static rerun.

Both failed runtime candidates remain in worker.json and are superseded by final worker and independent passes. Scope remains local logical identity, not sink durability, W09/W22/F16 closure or release.
